requested_params.instruction: Fill the audio semantic mask based on the given conditions:
requested_params.caption: Arena rock, pop rock. Determined, uplifting, driving. Powerful raspy rock male vocal, belted chorus with gang vocals, sung in English. Electric guitar, warm bass, live drum kit and sparse warm organ. Guitar riff intro, driving verses, build pre-chorus, anthemic chorus, half-time bridge, gang vocals final chorus, big ending outro. Huge stadium sound, wide distorted guitars, big drums. quiet determined verses, rising pre-chorus, powerful sung chorus, a brief guitar response. Vocal forward, natural phrasing.
requested_params.lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Cold coffee on the windowsill
Taped-up knuckles, standing still
Rain on the tin roof, boots by the door
Mud on my jeans from the night before

[Pre-Chorus]
Dust on my tongue and the crowd walking out
I tie my laces slow, no room for doubt

[Chorus]
One more step into the light
I’m still here, I’m still in the fight
Knees in the gravel, but I rise slow
Every heartbeat tells me where to go

[Verse 2]
Morning finds me on the cinder track
Same worn shoes, but I’m not looking back
Dad’s old voice is crackling on the phone
Says the porch light’s on, you’re not alone

[Pre-Chorus]
Dust on my tongue and the crowd walking out
I tie my laces slow, no room for doubt

[Chorus]
One more step into the light
I’m still here, I’m still in the fight
Knees in the gravel, but I rise slow
Every heartbeat tells me where to go

[Bridge]
I stopped counting all the times I fell
Started counting sunrises as well
Who I was is a shadow on the wall
Who I am is just getting up, that’s all

[Chorus]
One more step into the light
I’m still here, I’m still in the fight
Knees in the gravel, but I rise slow
Every heartbeat tells me where to go

[Outro]
